name: wickr
description: Welcome to the Amazon Web Services Wickr API Reference.

subcommands.name: batch-create-user
subcommands.description: Creates multiple users in a specified Wickr network.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-user
subcommands.description: Deletes multiple users from a specified Wickr network.

subcommands.name: batch-lookup-user-uname
subcommands.description: Looks up multiple user usernames from their unique username hashes (unames).

subcommands.name: batch-reinvite-user
subcommands.description: Resends invitation codes to multiple users who have pending invitations in a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: batch-reset-devices-for-user
subcommands.description: Resets multiple devices for a specific user in a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: batch-toggle-user-suspend-status
subcommands.description: Suspends or unsuspends multiple users in a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: create-bot
subcommands.description: Creates a new bot in a specified Wickr network.

subcommands.name: create-data-retention-bot
subcommands.description: Creates a data retention bot in a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: create-data-retention-bot-challenge
subcommands.description: Creates a new challenge password for the data retention bot.

subcommands.name: create-network
subcommands.description: Creates a new Wickr network with specified access level and configuration.

subcommands.name: create-security-group
subcommands.description: Creates a new security group in a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: delete-bot
subcommands.description: Deletes a bot from a specified Wickr network.

subcommands.name: delete-data-retention-bot
subcommands.description: Deletes the data retention bot from a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: delete-network
subcommands.description: Deletes a Wickr network and all its associated resources, including users, bots, security groups, and settings.

subcommands.name: delete-security-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a security group from a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: get-bot
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific bot in a Wickr network, including its status, group membership, and authentication details.

subcommands.name: get-bots-count
subcommands.description: Retrieves the count of bots in a Wickr network, categorized by their status (pending, active, and total).

subcommands.name: get-data-retention-bot
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the data retention bot in a Wickr network, including its status and whether the data retention service is enabled.

subcommands.name: get-guest-user-history-count
subcommands.description: Retrieves historical guest user count data for a Wickr network, showing the number of guest users per billing period over the past 90 days.

subcommands.name: get-network
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Wickr network, including its configuration, access level, and status.

subcommands.name: get-network-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves all network-level settings for a Wickr network, including client metrics, data retention, and other configuration options.

subcommands.name: get-oidc-info
subcommands.description: Retrieves the OpenID Connect (OIDC) configuration for a Wickr network, including SSO settings and optional token information if access token parameters are provided.

subcommands.name: get-opentdf-config
subcommands.description: Retrieves the OpenTDF integration configuration for a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: get-security-group
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific security group in a Wickr network, including its settings, member counts, and configuration.

subcommands.name: get-user
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific user in a Wickr network, including their profile, status, and activity history.

subcommands.name: get-users-count
subcommands.description: Retrieves the count of users in a Wickr network, categorized by their status (pending, active, rejected) and showing how many users can still be added.

subcommands.name: list-blocked-guest-users
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of guest users who have been blocked from a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: list-bots
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of bots in a specified Wickr network.

subcommands.name: list-devices-for-user
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of devices associated with a specific user in a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: list-guest-users
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of guest users who have communicated with your Wickr network.

subcommands.name: list-networks
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all Wickr networks associated with your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-security-group-users
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users who belong to a specific security group in a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: list-security-groups
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of security groups in a specified Wickr network.

subcommands.name: list-users
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users in a specified Wickr network.

subcommands.name: register-oidc-config
subcommands.description: Registers and saves an OpenID Connect (OIDC) configuration for a Wickr network, enabling Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication through an identity provider.

subcommands.name: register-oidc-config-test
subcommands.description: Tests an OpenID Connect (OIDC) configuration for a Wickr network by validating the connection to the identity provider and retrieving its supported capabilities.

subcommands.name: register-opentdf-config
subcommands.description: Registers and saves OpenTDF configuration for a Wickr network, enabling attribute-based access control for Wickr through an OpenTDF provider.

subcommands.name: update-bot
subcommands.description: Updates the properties of an existing bot in a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: update-data-retention
subcommands.description: Updates the data retention bot settings, allowing you to enable or disable the data retention service, or acknowledge the public key message.

subcommands.name: update-guest-user
subcommands.description: Updates the block status of a guest user in a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: update-network
subcommands.description: Updates the properties of an existing Wickr network, such as its name or encryption key configuration.

subcommands.name: update-network-settings
subcommands.description: Updates network-level settings for a Wickr network.

subcommands.name: update-security-group
subcommands.description: Updates the properties of an existing security group in a Wickr network, such as its name or settings.

subcommands.name: update-user
subcommands.description: Updates the properties of an existing user in a Wickr network.
